newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Process Equipment wins orders.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Process Equipment wins orders.

text.p: Integrated Process Equipment Corp said it has won an order for a PWS-300 Precision Wafer Shaper, marking the first order for the machine which shapes 300 millimeter wafers.
In addition, the company received an order to expand the installation of a waste water reclamation system using its Exxflow technology.
These two and other recent orders for products outside the company's chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) product line total $6 million, the company said in a statement.
